subject.title: fix(tlon): stop monitor tracking state from growing forever

question: Should Tlon mention-free thread participation be limited to the 2,000 most recently accessed parent IDs?
rationale: The cap cleanly bounds memory but deliberately changes message-delivery behavior for evicted active threads, so code correctness alone cannot establish the intended product policy.

options.title: Accept the 2,000-entry LRU
options.body: Approve the proposed access-refreshed window as the intended bounded Tlon delivery policy.

options.title: Choose another bounded lifecycle
options.body: Keep the invite generation fix but replace the count cap with a Tlon-owner-selected expiry or lifecycle rule.

recommendation.title: Accept the 2,000-entry LRU
recommendation.body: Approve the proposed access-refreshed window as the intended bounded Tlon delivery policy.

likelyOwner.reason: He reviewed and merged the feature expansion that established the affected Tlon monitor behavior, making him the strongest available owner for this delivery-policy decision.
